svg.title: STFE 2027 — Digital Exhibition Experience
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: One landing page does the selling: it explains the event, answers the price question up
front, shows the floor, and turns interest into an enquiry, a callback or a visitor registration
